text:
anya: Following up on the vendor outage postmortemwe need owners + clear deadlines for mitigations. Short answers ok.

matt: I'll own cloud failover gating + traffic-shift plan. Prototype in staging by Tue, can target canary rollout in two sprints. assigning: matt.

sara: I'll take model-registry hardening: download token TTLs, local cache, and latency instrumentation. draft runbook by Fri. assigning: sara.

tim: I'll do auth SDK resilience: circuit breaker, verification-only fallback token, and rotation alerts. will prototype this week. assigning: tim.

lucy: ops will build composite alerts and on-call playbook entries. target Wed. assigning: lucy.

anya: quick MVM decision: deployable in 14 days = cloud gating (matt) + registry cache (sara) + SDK cb (tim). Confirm?

matt: confirm. I'll add health probes + staged shift script. snippet:
```
health gating: mark region down after 3 failed probes
staged shift: 1% -> 10% -> 50% (30m holds)
DNS TTLs: 60s canaries, 300s general
```

sara: confirm. cache plan:
```
local artifact cache soft-ttl 10m
download token TTL 5m + refresh endpoint
instrument registry latency -> SLO 200ms
```

tim: confirm. auth plan:
```
SDK circuit breaker: open after 3 errs / 5s
verification-only fallback token held in KMS
daily smoke test for fallback path
feature-flagged rollout
```

lucy: composite alert: fire when registry errors >1% AND auth failures >0.5% for 10m. runbook will include scale-down non-critical jobs + page oncall.

infra-bot: matt triggered infra/health-gating:staging deploy at 2199991200 1 status: success.

anya: good progress. next steps: update the postmortem action tracker with owners, deadlines, and acceptance criteria. I'll run a 15m weekly "Dependency Mitigation Standup" until closed.

lucy: calendar invite sent.

matt: I'll PR infra scripts and link the traffic-shift checklist.

sara: will open cache + metrics PR Monday.

tim: will open SDK PR behind a flag and tag platforms team for review.

anya: thanks everyone. if blockers appear ping me. closing thread until next check-in. :white_check_mark:
